input.reason: The request maps to the existing Todo.done field (the codebase's completion flag). Two units must change in lockstep: types gains a "clear" Command variant, and commands implements clear() (filter out done todos), parses "clear" from argv, and wires it into run() with load/save persistence. storage and format are unaffected.

steps.instruction: Add a new zero-argument variant to the exported Command union: { kind: "clear" }. Keep the existing add/complete/list variants and nextId exactly as they are. Do not change the Todo interface — the request's "completed field" is this codebase's existing done: boolean flag.

The types unit is adding a { kind: "clear" } variant to the Command union this same round. (1) Add an exported function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[] that returns a NEW array containing only todos whose done is false (i.e. removes every todo with done === true), preserving the original order of the remaining todos, and never mutating the input array. (2) Update parseArgs so the single argument "clear" parses to { kind: "clear" } with no extra fields, consistent with how zero-argument commands like "list" are parsed. (3) Update run to handle kind "clear": load the todos from the given path, remove all todos with done === true, save the remaining list back to the same path, and return a short non-empty human-readable message (e.g. stating how many todos were cleared). When nothing is done, still save (the unchanged list is fine) and still return output. Do not change add, complete, list, or their existing behaviours.
steps.interfaceChange: export declare function clear(todos: Todo[]): Todo[];
